cells.forex: Needs a broker; leverage limits and product rules differ by country, and some brokers are unregulated.
cells.stocks: Needs a broker with access to the exchange; account minimums and fees vary.
cells.penny_stocks: Some brokers limit or block trading in them; some venues have extra rules and warnings.
cells.commodities: Product choice depends on the broker and country; some routes need larger accounts.
cells.futures: Often needs an approved account; one contract can be large compared with a small account.

caveat: Access depends on your country, the regulator, the broker and the account type. Check that any broker is properly regulated where you live before opening an account.
